sql.query: SELECT id FROM tbl_users WHERE id=:userId AND isActive=1 AND isPlatformAdmin=1 LIMIT 1

SELECT t.id tenantId,t.tenantName,t.tenantType,t.lifecycleStatus,t.accessStartDate,t.accessEndDate,t.retentionEndDate,t.cleanupEligibleDate,t.convertedToLiveDate,t.lifecycleModifiedDate,i.id scenarioInstanceId,i.status scenarioStatus,i.currentStepId,s.sequenceNumber currentStep,p.id scenarioPackId,p.scenarioName,p.scenarioCode FROM tbl_tenants t LEFT JOIN tbl_scenario_instances i ON i.id=(SELECT latest.id FROM tbl_scenario_instances latest WHERE latest.tenantId=t.id ORDER BY latest.id DESC LIMIT 1) LEFT JOIN tbl_scenario_packs p ON p.id=i.scenarioPackId LEFT JOIN tbl_scenario_steps s ON s.id=i.currentStepId WHERE t.isActive=1 ORDER BY t.tenantName
SELECT id,scenarioCode,versionNumber,scenarioName FROM tbl_scenario_packs WHERE status='published' ORDER BY scenarioName,versionNumber DESC

SELECT h.id,h.tenantId,t.tenantName,h.actionCode,h.previousTenantType,h.newTenantType,h.previousLifecycleStatus,h.newLifecycleStatus,h.previousAccessEndDate,h.newAccessEndDate,h.reason,h.changedDate,COALESCE(u.displayName,'System') changedBy FROM tbl_tenant_lifecycle_history h INNER JOIN tbl_tenants t ON t.id=h.tenantId LEFT JOIN tbl_users u ON u.id=h.changedByUserId ORDER BY h.changedDate DESC,h.id DESC LIMIT 100
